linked_prs.title: Revert model to gpt-3.5-turbo when gpt-4 is not available.
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/ai.py b/ai.py
index dc332cf6eb..7ed0a3fc0f 100644
--- a/ai.py
+++ b/ai.py
@@ -6,6 +6,14 @@ class AI:
     def __init__(self, **kwargs):
         self.kwargs = kwargs
 
+        try:
+            openai.Model.retrieve("gpt-4")
+        except openai.error.InvalidRequestError:
+            print("Model gpt-4 not available for provided api key reverting "
+                  "to gpt-3.5.turbo. Sign up for the gpt-4 wait list here: "
+                  "https://openai.com/waitlist/gpt-4-api")
+            self.kwargs['model'] = "gpt-3.5-turbo"
+
     def start(self, system, user):
         messages = [
                 {"role": "system", "content": system},
@@ -36,4 +44,4 @@ def next(self, messages: list[dict[str, str]], prompt=None):
             msg = delta.get('content', '')
             print(msg, end="")
             chat.append(msg)
-        return messages + [{"role": "assistant", "content": "".join(chat)}]
\ No newline at end of file
+        return messages + [{"role": "assistant", "content": "".join(chat)}]
